Hey! How is it going?\n...That's good. Keep up the good work.\nMonsters are coming one after another.
Meh, other monsters are increasing.\nThis should be because of the monster octopus...\nHm? Didn't I tell you about it? Oh, sorry.
A big octopus appeared in the sea a few years ago.\nAnd it came to attack this beach.\nWell, it was tough...
Fortunately, there were knights and well-known\nmages, and they drove it away but I think\nthe monsters are increasing since then...
The monster octopus could be around here and\nsending little monsters to this beach...\nWell, it's just my guess.
Hey, what's up? You are hunting monsters all the\ntime after coming here, and I bet you are bored,\naren't ya? Why don't we have a chat?
...Lalun? You like her? ...Just kidding! Huh?\nWhy is she working at here with a stern guy like\nme, you ask? How outspoken you are!
Well, she started working before I asked.\nShe was lying in front of my store one day.\nI was so surprised!
Then, as soon as she woke up, she said,\nI like the sea so I wanna work for here!!\nWell, I was short of hands so I accepted...
She tends to take people lightly, but she's cute\nand respect me as her boss... So, there's no\nreason to lay off her. Wait, why are you smirking?!
Hey, don't do such a face.\nYou're hungry, right? You don't have to say it.\nI can tell. Do you wanna eat something here?
How was it? Was there something you like in\nthe menu? Great! Eating what you like is the\nbest way to cheer up!
Oh? Hey, I know I gave it to you but...\nYour equipment look kind of poor...\nWhy not you get the better one?
...Huh? Not free, of course not...\nWait! Listen! I'll give you a discount.\nJust for you. Wait a moment, I'll bring it.
Okay, get rid of the monsters in the sea so Potum\ncan play safely! I'm counting on you!
Hey! It's you. Thanks for defeating those things!!\nUsually we would be closing the beach house down\nby now.
But people are still coming in like the waves and\nsales are still pretty good. So I don't feel any\nneed to wrap things up just yet.
Well, I have mixed feelings because most of the\npeople were adventurers like you who came to\nget Fisherman Points.
Well, I can't say thank you enough for getting\nrid of monsters. I'll open the exchange for you\nafter closing the house for a while.
Come again if you still have Fisherman Points left\nWell, I won't be able to keep it open for a long\ntime, so you might wanna exchange earlier.
Sorry for dragging you into all of this.\nBut that means I know you've got mad skills!\nI believe in you!
Yo, I appreciate your hard work.\nOh...It seems like you haven't finished collecting\nthem. I know it's not easy, do your best!

Hey, adventurer! What's up?\nSorry, my boss works his men hard...\nThough he looks scary, he's sometimes cute heh heh!
Wanna know it? Okay, I'll tell you.\nWhenever pretty things catch his eyes, the corners\nof his eyes go downward and looks so funny!
He often feeds Potums coming to swim with floats.\nBut they never get friendly.\nI kinda feel sorry for him tho...
One more thing! He writes poems!!\nYou know how it goes like? His words are all girly!\nRead it and you could die of breathing problems!!
Whoa! No! He's approaching us!!\nAdventurer, don't tell him that I said it!\nBye...
Whazzup?, adventurer! You got Fisherman Points?\nI can exchange them for something good!
Did you like it? Glad to hear that...\nWhat? You want more different items?
Hmm, it's not something I can handle...\nTell my boss about the lineup!\nThanks in advance for hunting monsters!
Whoa, it's the adventurer. We owe you a lot.\nNow the beach is safe. Thank you so much.
Our business went really well. But surprisingly,\nmost of the customers came to hunt monsters\nnot to enjoy swimming...
*sigh* ....Huh? Well, the summer ends soon and\nthe beach house will be closed.\nI feel kind of lonely every year...
Exchange will be open for a while though.\nIf you still have Fisherman Points, exchange them\nfor items as soon as possible.
Though I said for a while, it won't be so long.\nSo, the earlier, the better.

My boss has always taught me to be fair in\ndoing business, but I'm always supporting\nthe adventurers, so please win for sure!
Pom, pom pom pom pom!\nCome on! Here's your apples!!
Heh, boss. You're still trying?\nIt's impossible. You look scary.
Shut up!\nThey might notice my affection, some time!!
Oh? Oh my, sorry I didn't notice.\nBoss, what are you doing?!\nHere's our customer!!
Welcome. I'm Lalun.\nNice to see ya!
Welcome to Saltau Beach!!
...Hm? Aye, it's my private beach and I run\na beach house here...
Huh? Take money cuz it's my beach?\nDa ha ha!! No way, I'm not a miser!
Yup, yup.\nIf we charged a fee for such a tiny beach, that\nwould be rip-off.
What?! Rip-off?! ...Well, just eat something\nhere and lend some goods for playing in the\nwater, diving and such...
Big-hearted? Heh, you flatter me.
Nope, nope. If he was big-hearted, my pay would've\nbeen higher...
You jerk... Maybe as a reward for your hard work\nyou'll enjoy a nice sleep with the fishes?
Pyaaaa, I'm sorry!\nI went too far!
Meh... W-Welp, greed won't get me anywhere...
By the way, don't know why but young girls call me\n[Sally] these days♪
They are very friendly to me.\nIt's good actually but I just wonder why...
So, this beach is supposed to be full of visitors!\nHaving said that...
Now the sea is full of monsters.\nWhy? We're in trouble cuz we don't know why.
I was hunting monsters everytime I get in the\nwater but there are too many... What is worse,\nthere's a huge one off the shore.
And it's too hard for me to fight alone...\nHuh? She?
No way, Diels are good at hunting but not in the\nwater. She's useless.
Come on! Why do you have to speak like that...?
*sigh* ...I wish there was a Straye adventurer\nwho can help us out with getting rid of monsters...
Yea, a skilled adventurer should be...\nHm? Hmmmmm?!
Hellooooooo!!
Hey! Help us out!!\nDid you know, you can get Fisherman Points\neverytime you hunt monsters?
If you get points, you can exchange for special\nitems! You can't miss this chance. So, please!
I'm begging you!!
Cool!! Alright, let's do it...\nOh, before that, you can't hunt monsters with\nthe weapon you have.
So, can you bring the weapon I give you?
Boss, adventurer, good luck!

Umm...well, isn't it a beautiful beach?
Oh! You actually understand the beauty of this\nprivate beach of mine! Great taste!
Oh, adventurer! Welcome~!\nWe no longer see those monsters here and our\nbusiness is doing great!
Wow, do you guys really make that much money?
Yeah! Some divers claimed to have found some kind\nof underwater ruins. Thanks to them, this place is\nflooded with customers every day.
Underwater ruins?!\nSounds like something that can make me rich!\nTell me more about it!
Right, explain it to us!
Also, who let you guys do business here?
W-who are you?
Me? I'm a Fixion merchant.\nMy name's Figo. I'm also the owner of this beach.\nNice to meetchu.
Here, as you can see, I also have the deed.\nSo that means the underwater ruins also\nbelong to me...
W-what on earth are you babbling about?
W-what? You got a problem with that?
Umm? This deed is weird.\nWhere's the name of the previous owner?
Oh?! Um, uh...ah...\nY-you know...
Besides, Fixion people are extremely fussy when it\ncomes to buying and selling land, so the deed\nshould be as thick as a book...
W-well, does any of you here have a deed then?!
There's no such thing!!
I did say that this is my private beach!\nThat's because I was the one who cleaned up and\norganized this abandoned beach.
But, the visitors are never made to pay a crazy\namount or prohibited from visiting! I think this\nplace belongs to everyone who comes to have fun!
Moreover, the pristine underwater ruins that have\nbeen untouched by humans do not belong to anybody.\nIsn't it so?
I see...You've got a point there.\nThey don't belong to anybody.\nUh-huh...
Hey, what are you trying to say?
Saltau, have you seen anyone that came back with\nsomething from the underwater ruins?
Huh? As far as I know, no one has ever been\ninside.
Oh ho ho ho!\nPelulu, did you hear that?\nThat means they're still really untouched.
Oh no, why did you tell him that!\nYou know you own the land if you develop and\nmaintain it or if someone gives it to you.
But that's not the case with valuable underwater\nartifacts and sunken ship. The first person who\nsalvages them gets the right to keep them first...
Just what you would expect from a Pelulu! In other\nwords, I only need to find and bring home a single\ntreasure from the ruins to make them mine!!
Huh? Well then, I'll just need to do it before you\nand the entire underwater ruins will be mine!
Hey, stop daydreaming already and\nlet's go to hunt the treasure now!
Hold on! The reason why no one's ever been inside\nthe ruins is because it's dangerous. Some monsters\nwent on a rampage in the sea recently you know.
And I heard there are monsters near the ruins too!\nThe adventurer may be fine, but Figo, right?\nCan you dive and fight?
I see. Well, I'm only good at counting money\nand I'm terrible at sports.\nFine, I'll just let this person go then.
Oh?! You guys!!
Oh, good to see you again!
S-shut up!\nWho do you think started this whole mess!
Anyway, if we don't act now, the underwater ruins\nmay be taken by that cheeky rich bastard...\nAdventurer, can I ask for your help?
Huh?! You don't even need to ask.\nWe'll definitely get the treasure before him!
Could it be that you're planning to steal my\ntreasure? I won't let that happen!
I don't need any treasure! I'll let you have\neverything! I just want the underwater ruins to be\nleft alone for the people who come to dive to see.
Aww, you're a real ocean lover!!
For real?! You shoulda told me earlier!\nIf everything goes well, the rewards and the\ntreasure are both mine...That's super awesome!!
Alright! It's a race.\nThe first to bring the treasure from the\nunderwater ruins here is the winner.
I guess you hear that! Let's get movin'!
Hey wait!\nIf it's a race, we should start at the same time,\notherwise it's not fair!
He's got a point.\nYou guys should wait until he's ready.
I should just grab everything now cuz I don't\nwanna waste time coming back here every time.\nMr. Figo, please take care of the bill.
You're preparing various equipment for\nthe adventurer, you're gonna prepare some for\nme too, right?
What?!\nWhy should I treat someone who's trying to\ntake over this beach well?!
Lalun, he's still a customer anyway.\nPrepare for him too!
Humph...fine.\nI'll prepare them.
Thanks for shopping ♪
Hey...do I really need all of this?
That made quite a dent in my wallet...\nI guess I have no choice. I'll think of it as an\ninitial investment to get the treasure...
You can now leave for [ffff64]Underwater Ruins[ffffff]\nby talking to Pelulu.
You came back so fast! How was it?
T-the...\nThe ruins at the bottom of the sea have\ncrumbled...
W-whaat?!\nDoes that mean you didn't bring anything valuable\nfor me?!
Aw, this is so stupid.\nWell, I'm ending our contract completely.\nI appreciate your hard work.
Oh, no!
Geez, nothing good ever happens\nevery time I'm with you guys!\nNow I need to find a new source of income...
Well, think of it as us sharing the pain.\nHumans just needs to work hard!\nYou should keep working hard too!
Shut up!\nI don't need you to lecture me!!
Too bad there's no treasure...But you, keeping the\nbeach safe for the visitors is more than enough.\nHere, take your rewards!
By the way, that masked guy is an acquaintance of\nyours?
Speaking of that guy, who was he again?
Wait, wait, wait!\nYou were talking to him as if you really know him,\nthough?!
Umm, I feel like I've seen him somewhere, but...
Seriously? You're amazing, in a way...
That masked man's name was...
Maskman
Minotaur
Secret Agent B
Riggy
Ruzart
Eidenliebe
My name is Ruzaaaaart!!
Hey, hey, cut it out~!\nWhat are you two old farts doing!!
Whoo, it's Pelulu and the adventurer,\nyou guys came at the right time! I want you guys\nto stop my boss and this cheeky rich old geezer!!
Uh oh, you were not supposed to see this...\nUhm, no no no.\nI'm not here to be a land shark.
Well, the geologist working on the research I\nfinance told me that there are quite many veins of\nGoddess Beads around here...
Goddess Beads?!
I can make a killing if I'm able to find them!\nI told him that I'd pay him a reasonable amount of\nmoney if he let me do some digging, but...
This guy is so hardheaded and he persistently says\nno to me...
What a joke, you said you didn't know where the\nGoddess Beads are buried.
I won't let you just randomly dig and\nmake this beach full of holes!!\nThat'd be an awful sight! Never!!
As you can see, they'll never be on the same\npage...
In that case, lemme handle it!
W-what are you gonna do?
I've found Goddess Beads quite a few times\nbefore, dug them up and sold them.
And I gradually came to realize that Goddess\nBeads have a faint scent that only the Cules can\nperceive as we have a keen sense of smell...
F-f-for real?!
If there are really many of them buried down here,\nthe scent must be pretty strong too, so I think\nwe'll be able to find them without digging around!
Alright, if you say so...\nI'm fine as long as you don't damage the beach,\ngo ahead and try then.
Anyway, I'm also a Cule, but I don't think I've\never perceived the scent you were talking about...
While living in luxury, you must have forgotten\nall the unique sensory skills belonging to the\nCules, right?
Uh-oh, um...n-not really...\nOhh, I can't deny that...
Well, let's start searching from where the scent\nsomehow comes from...*sniff-sniff*
Wait, wait, wait! What are ya doin'?!\nThat's already the sea!\nAre you planning to drown yourself?!
Oh gosh! That was close!\nI got too obsessed with finding the scent...
Hey!\nWhy are you following me?
I know you'll claim the Goddess Beads being yours\nif you find the veins.
Then you'll set your price and ask me to buy them\nfrom you!
Oops! Tee-hee-hee...You're a genius...
We're both merchants and Cules, so I know exactly\nwhat's in your mind!
Therefore, I'mma follow you and claim the\nGoddess Beads for myself too!!
Tee-hee, tee-hee-hee-hee-hee...
Um?
It's very faint but it smells like\nGoddess Beads...
Umm...I think I can smell the Goddess Beads\nahead of us...
But...ahead of us is the sea, isn't it?!\nHow is it possible?\nIt's some kind of mistake, isn't it?
Umm, you don't believe me?\nFine, you can stay here then. I'll go with this\nadventurer and come back with the Goddess Beads...
No, no, no, waitt!\nThat's exactly how you want it to be!\nDream on, I'm coming with you!!
Are you asking me if I'm sure about the scent\ncoming from the sea? Um, honestly...it's just\nmy instinct.
My gut simply tells me the beads are there.\nYou also know that my instincts are never wrong,\ndon't you?
...What? You don't know?\nAnyway, you'll know when we get there. Let's go!!
Umm, a monster that's scattering Goddess Beads.\nWhat a disaster!
Er...I don't quite get it, is it like the Goddess\nBeads turned into a monster?
Isn't it more like a monster that absorbs the\nenergy of Goddess Beads and is able to crystallize\nit once again with its body?
But the crystallization was incomplete and only\nunstable beads that explode easily were created...
The purple and purplish red crystals found inside\nthe cave look like the Goddess Beads which energy\nhas been absorbed by the monster...
Well, you should be grateful that you're still\nalive.\nAs long as we're alive, there's always hope!
But I feel like it's such a waste.\nI don't care about the Goddess Beads scattered by\nthe monster, but...
The crystals in the cave were rare jewels and I\ncould have sold them for a big juicy profit...
Oh well...I won't make much from selling those\nbead fragments anyway...
Besides, selling fake jewels and tricking people\nlike that is just not my way of doing business...
Hey, have you bumped your head?!\nYou're suddenly acting like a nice guy!
The ocean cleanses people's heart indeed!\nAmazing!!
Huff...I just...wanted to make a killing overnight\nby finding a massive deposit of Goddess Beads!!
It seems to me that your heart didn't get\ncleansed well enough...

Oh, it's hot!
Oh! It's seems to be open.
It's good to see you two here!
Hi adventurer and Pelulu! Welcome~!
How's your business? Are you making money?
Well, actually...
It's okay during the day, but...
Hm? You guys are also open at night?\nDo customers come though?
Not until very late though, but yeah we're open \neven after sunset.
It's just that......
There have been some strange rumors going around\nhere recently.
Rumors?
About treasures?
Hm? What is it about?
Yeah, they say some strange mist forms near the\nbeach at night. I've never seen it though.
Besides, they say an eerie sound like the howl of\na monster can be heard too~!
Because of rumors like that, our business has\nkinda slowed down.
What is it, what is it?!\nTreasures?! Are they rumors about treasures?!
Uh, no. Not anything like that.
When the night comes, there's this mist-like thing\nthat appears around here...Moreover, a sound like\nthat of a monster can be heard too.
Because of that, our business is kinda slow now.
Well, I have a rough idea of what it actually is.\nYou see, the sea has become safe because the\nadventurer has been slaying the monsters.
That's why this time I suspect that it's the\nmonsters on land and at the seaside that come out.
But no one has ever seen it clearly before.\nHonestly, I give up.
Hm~......\nWell, it's just a rumor anyway.
But, I think it's possible if we wanna find out\nabout it. So, I wonder if you can do us a little\nfavor.
We'd like you two to find out the truth behind the\nrumors for us~.
Agreeing to do something like that won't benefit\nme in any way.
If it's a monster, you can handle it alone right?\nWell then, something urgent has come up, so I\ngotta go now.
Well, you know...I just want you to check and\nconfirm it. If there's nothing, it's fine too.
Whether there is monster or not, I still plan to\nreward you properly.
Alright!\nIf there's a reward, I can consider it!
What a money-grabber...
Anyway, I'm grateful that you agree to do it.\nYou know, just proving that there's actually\nnothing will really make a difference.
Alright, you guys will be acting like our security\nguards then. We're relying on you!
So it wasn't a monster, but a ghost?\nOh. this is bad.
It's good that we now know the truth, but if we\ndon't do anything, it'll really ruin our business.
Gosh! That was a disaster!
So what are you gonna do now?\nIf it's a ghost, there's nothing we can do, you\nknow?
But if I don't do anything, customers will stop\ncoming.
So there's something I'd like you to do for me.
Weren't you listening?!\nI think I told you there was nothing we could do\nabout this!
I never say that I want you to fight the ghost.\nBesides, whatever the adventurer does will have no\neffect on the ghost, right?
Have you got an idea , boss?
Yeah, I need you to collect some things for that.\nMay I ask you to do it?
Well, if it's just that, it's fine...\nBut if you tell me to fight the ghost, no thanks!
Also we need another reward for this!
Oh! It seems that you've collected what I want.
But what are you going to do with them?
Is he gonna make something with them?
Well, just wait for the fun later tonight!\nTrust me, I've got this!
Ugh...I'll stay out of it.
You can go by yourself!\nI'll come to get my reward later!
Okay!\nI'll volunteer to replace Pelulu then!\nI'll go with the adventurer!
W-wait, are you out of your mind?!\nIt's a ghost, you know?! I repeat, it's a ghost!
Honestly, I kinda wanna see a ghost at least once!\nAn opportunity like this doesn't come around very\noften.
Well, I'd appreciate it if you wanna go and see it\nfor yourself.
Alright then, give me a sign when you see the\nghost. Also make sure you don't do anything\nstupid.
Leave it to me!
This time you've helped me again with things that\nhappened at this private beach.\nThank you. Please take this!
Anyway, that idea was great. I never thought of\nit.
How did it work?
Oh, I made a launcher with the materials you\ncollected. Then I fired it up into the night sky.
It shoots glowing seashells. They'll come back\ndown after a while, but they'll fall into the sea\nand return to nature.
Wow! Other than keeping ghosts away, maybe it can\nbecome an attraction at the night beach too.\nHehe, I smell a new business opportunity here...!
Oh, you're a smart girl!\nAnyway, that light had quite an effect!
It was amazing!
I know right?\nIt turns out that ghosts are really weak to\nlight,.
I can't believe you didn't know about that!!!
Well, I believe you guys would somehow make it\nwork if things didn't go well!
U-um, we'll throw in something extra for you\nwhenever you come~, so please keep supporting our\nbusiness!
